conditional_null.frozen_conclusion: Frozen Q5.1 TTF-C has a reproducible positive conditional-null expectation on heterogeneous Q5 geometry under independent private relation phases.

normalization_bias.frozen_conclusion: Final residual-SD normalization measurably amplifies the positive conditional-null bias but is not necessary; the dominant mechanism lies upstream of the final rescaling.

scientific_target: Test whether heterogeneous geometry induces a nonzero phase-averaged training response through edge-specific private-boundary crossing propensity that survives the Q5.1 rank-length projection, and whether that deterministic mean response is necessary for the positive TTF-C conditional-null bias.

mechanistic_identity.private_relation_side: For phase phi, an observation at circular angle theta is on side 1 iff sin(theta-phi) >= 0.
mechanistic_identity.edge_angular_separation: delta_e is the shortest circular angular separation between the two edge endpoints, constrained to [0, pi].
mechanistic_identity.crossing_probability: For phi uniform on [0, 2*pi), P(edge e crosses the private relation boundary | geometry) = delta_e / pi.
mechanistic_identity.binary_rank_identity: For m edges and crossing fraction q(phi), rank01 of the binary crossing indicator equals 0.5 - 0.5*q(phi) + 0.5*I_e(phi).
mechanistic_identity.phase_expected_centered_rank: Therefore E_phi[rank01(I_e)-0.5 | geometry] = 0.5*(p_e - mean_e p_e), where p_e = delta_e/pi.
mechanistic_identity.q51_linear_projection: The unscaled Q5.1 rank-length residual is a linear projection of centered turnover rank off centered rank(edge length), so its phase expectation is obtained by applying that same fixed linear projection to 0.5*(p_e-mean p).
mechanistic_identity.prediction: If this deterministic edge-phase propensity residual is the upstream geometry-conditioned mechanism, subtracting the analytically fixed phase-expected residual from each training phase response should remove most or all of the positive conditional-null mean on fresh heterogeneous geometry while leaving the homogeneous negative control centered.

baseline_unscaled_q51.training_response: Exact Q5.1 centered rank-length residual before final residual-SD normalization, as frozen by the normalization-bias diagnosis.
baseline_unscaled_q51.score: Ordinary held-out within-system Spearman, equal-system macro mean.

phase_propensity_centered_ablation.single_change: From each baseline training response edge, subtract the geometry-only analytic phase expectation of the unscaled Q5.1 residual derived from p_e = delta_e/pi. No empirical or realized held-out response enters this quantity.

fresh_worlds.freshness: No geometry world or private-phase redraw from any earlier TTF-C diagnosis may be reused.

predeclared_mechanism_tests.matched_baseline_bias_replication: SUPPORTED iff lower95 of across-geometry mean conditional_mean_baseline_C in DPP_MATCHED is > 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.matched_phase_propensity_contribution: SUPPORTED iff lower95 of paired across-geometry mean (baseline minus propensity-centered conditional mean) in DPP_MATCHED is > 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.matched_propensity_centered_recentered: SUPPORTED iff the two-sided 95% bootstrap CI for mean conditional_mean_propensity_centered_C in DPP_MATCHED contains 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.primary_phase_propensity_mechanism: SUPPORTED iff matched_baseline_bias_replication, matched_phase_propensity_contribution, and matched_propensity_centered_recentered are all supported.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.shifted_baseline_bias_replication: SUPPORTED iff lower95 of mean conditional_mean_baseline_C in DPP_SHIFTED is > 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.shifted_phase_propensity_contribution: SUPPORTED iff lower95 of paired baseline-minus-centered mean in DPP_SHIFTED is > 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.shifted_propensity_centered_recentered: SUPPORTED iff the two-sided 95% bootstrap CI for mean conditional_mean_propensity_centered_C in DPP_SHIFTED contains 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.homogeneous_negative_control: Report both arms, their paired difference, and analytic expected-residual RMS without using this cell to tune or select any correction.

terminal_rule.if_supported: Freeze only the edge-phase propensity mechanism diagnosis. The propensity-centered ablation is not thereby selected. Any corrective estimator requires a separately named prospective development family with a new frozen prediction and fresh worlds.
terminal_rule.if_not_supported: Freeze the negative diagnosis and do not tune crossing-propensity centering, angular-distance transforms, residual offsets, or related thresholds on these worlds.
